title: SQL injection via format\! in test_set_admin_password
description: db.rs:119. The test_set_admin_password function uses format\! to interpolate the argon2 hash directly into a SQL string: format\!("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO admin ... VALUES (1, '{}', 0)", hash). Argon2 hashes contain dollar signs and slashes but not SQL-injectable characters in practice. However, this pattern is unsafe by construction — if the hash ever contained a single quote, it would be injectable. This is test-only code (#[cfg(test)]) so production is not affected, but it sets a bad pattern that contributors may copy.
